segments.name: Investment Company
segments.description: A business development company generating current income and capital appreciation through debt and equity investments in U.S. middle-market companies.
segments.evidence: PennantPark Investment Corporation is a BDC whose objectives are to generate both current income and capital appreciation while seeking to preserve capital through debt and equity investments primarily made to U.S. middle-market companies in the form of first lien secured debt, second lien secured debt, subordinated debt and equity investments.
